author: Codex root
status: contribution screening; no new model execution or RTL build
direction: A: late-authorized in-flight source sharing under bounded storage
hypothesis: Combine a verified retained-response replay, independent permission frontiers and immutable old-transaction obligations to admit a late recipient without a new payload buffer. A distinct implementation contribution requires a measured total-cost advantage or an additional proved legal behavior beyond published pending-merge/patching and a fully specified finite-history control.

current_evidence.stage78: Five actual joins read 257 beats. Full-ready ordinary startup read 256 and was faster in five comparisons. Genuine prepare-order0 cases did not join and matched ordinary results.
current_evidence.inputs_already_available: Independent successful source READ and destination WRITE certificates, matching source PA/normal attributes, parent identities, logical-return counters, promised write ends and actual raw-W counters.
current_evidence.scope: Immutable aligned normal memory; one pair of 2 KiB jobs per reset. Real arbitrary late submission, warm continuous jobs and grant epochs are not implemented.

primary_sources_read.positions: paragraphs corresponding to web lines 972-986 and 1545-1551
primary_sources_read.covered: Pending same-block merge, adjustable waiting windows and multicast return masks; no claim that this read alone establishes the identical partial-burst/per-DMA-authority implementation.
DMA broadcast from one source to two destinations; does not establish the identical late-independent-job contract.
Late client prefix catch-up, hierarchical merging and finite-buffer extensions; not an AXI/IOMMU area result.

root_constructed_counterexamples.claim_rejected: The existing join can guarantee zero additional leader return delay for arbitrary legal physical response timing.
root_constructed_counterexamples.derivation: A captured shared beat enters the one global skid with pending mask 11. The single upstream logical R channel first delivers V, then A. While any recipient remains pending, physical ready is zero because eligible_r requires !skid_q. With the next physical beat already VALID, solo V can clear its skid one cycle earlier than the shared pair even if A is always ready. If A is not ready, the gap can be longer.
root_constructed_counterexamples.scope: A source-derived legal response/backpressure schedule, not a newly run DUT failure or a statement that every existing measured run has this delay.
root_constructed_counterexamples.consequence: A future no-leader-tax claim must specify return topology and a genuine acceptance reservation. Adding a second return path must be charged and compared to an ordinary multicast implementation. It cannot be inferred from zero extra payload storage.

root_constructed_counterexamples.claim_rejected: N+J physical data reads demonstrate a novel optimal late-join algorithm by themselves.
root_constructed_counterexamples.conditional_bound: At a chosen join boundary J, if the leader has already obtained the first J arbitrary immutable beats, the late recipient has obtained none of them, and only H of those beats are available for lawful replay across all counted local storage, at least max(0,J-H) additional data fetches are required. Total physical data fetches are at least N+max(0,J-H). This does not prove that the bound is achievable with in-order delivery or bounded service.
root_constructed_counterexamples.required_assumptions: Count all replay-accessible payload, including private FIFO/W staging and caches if usable; count rereads from leader destinations or any other memory address as data fetches. No uncharged history, compression or source-changing oracle. Permission to replay must still be independently obtained.
root_constructed_counterexamples.countercontrol: J=1,H=1 yields the trivial N lower bound. The old global skid physically retains beat0 after valid clears. Replaying it and joining subsequent beats is a concrete stronger control hypothesis, not an implemented or measured control.
root_constructed_counterexamples.consequence: The conditional counting bound and the prefix-patching principle are insufficient novelty evidence. A policy or architecture must add a demonstrated capability or total-cost advantage.

positive_remaining_test.rule_to_screen: Use already retained response storage only after its job/epoch/PA/byte identity is independently verified; retire immutable W debt before changing future member masks; reserve recipient acceptance independently of full destination authorization. Compare the same frozen-response and bounded-history contract in ordinary pending merge, prefix patch and credit multicast.
positive_remaining_test.information_cost: Replay validity/index/epoch and reservation metadata, full per-context authority, per-member logical-last/debt state and any extra return ports or combinational fanout must be charged. Existing physical bits are not free semantic validation.
positive_remaining_test.falsifier: A specified ordinary finite-history/pending-merge implementation has identical legal actions and equal or lower complete cost; or any benefit comes only from uncharged return ports/history, an imposed solo start despite known permits, or stopping V to make an alignment window.
positive_remaining_test.go_condition: A concrete legal late-job case and costed mechanism expose an extra capability or a nontrivial cost/performance point relative to actual primary prior work and executable simple controls. Only then build a minimal RTL case.
positive_remaining_test.current_decision: Do not add a new late-job/continuous-job RTL fixture now. Direction A remains a conditional integration/cost candidate, with lower immediate priority than a direction producing a genuine discriminating rule.
